signature.name: VTask.cons
signature.type: {ι : Type u_1} -> [DecidableEq ι] -> {α : ι → Sort u_2} -> (i : ι) -> (l : List ι) -> (a : α i) -> (f : (j : ι) → j ∈ l → α j) -> (j : ι) -> j ∈ i :: l → α j

conventions.statement: When the query index j equals i, VTask.cons i l a f j hj returns a (transported along the equality proof).
conventions.note: Priority is given to the head: if j = i the tail function f is not consulted, even if i also appears in l.

conventions.statement: When the query index j is not equal to i, membership in i :: l is resolved to membership in l, and f j is returned.
conventions.note: This means f must cover all j ∈ l; the cons constructor extends f with one new case at i.

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type} [DecidableEq ι] {α : ι → Sort*} (i : ι) (l : List ι) (a : α i) (f : ∀ j ∈ l, α j) (hj : i ∈ i :: l), VTask.cons i l a f i hj = a

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type} [DecidableEq ι] {α : ι → Sort*} (i : ι) (l : List ι) (a : α i) (f : ∀ j ∈ l, α j) (j : ι) (hj : j ∈ i :: l) (hne : j ≠ i), VTask.cons i l a f j hj = f j ((List.mem_cons.mp hj).resolve_left hne)

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type} [DecidableEq ι] {α α' : ι → Sort*} (i : ι) (l : List ι) (a : α i) (f : ∀ j ∈ l, α j) (φ : ∀ ⦃j⦄, α j → α' j) (j : ι) (hj : j ∈ i :: l), φ (VTask.cons i l a f j hj) = VTask.cons i l (φ a) (fun j hj => φ (f j hj)) j hj

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type} [DecidableEq ι] {α : ι → Sort*} {r : ∀ ⦃i : ι⦄, α i → α i → Prop} {i : ι} {l : List ι} {a₁ a₂ : α i} {f₁ f₂ : ∀ j ∈ l, α j}, r a₁ a₂ → (∀ (k : ι) (hk : k ∈ l), r (f₁ k hk) (f₂ k hk)) → ∀ (j : ι) (hj : j ∈ i :: l), r (VTask.cons i l a₁ f₁ j hj) (VTask.cons i l a₂ f₂ j hj)
